description: Prepare creating one partner vault of the wallet's own, with a free name, lending one asset (USDG, or a lend asset) against tokens of one universe: the wallet manages it for good, and it lends what depositors bring. Who may create: anyone while its generation's creation is open, otherwise a partner gage admitted. Returns the next unsigned transaction; never signs.

asset.description: The asset the vault lends: USDG when omitted, or a lend asset gage_capabilities lists (its token address)

buyLoans.description: It buys running loans other vaults of its generation sell, when they pay at least the model's return plus this; off when omitted

extraBps.description: The extra return a year asked above the model's, bps

buysOnly.description: true: it buys running loans alone and funds no new loan, for good; needs buyLoans

cashKeptFreeBps.description: The share of the vault a new loan must leave free in cash, bps; 0 when omitted

collateral.description: The tokens it lends against, of one universe; every token its generation admits in `universe` when omitted

feeBps.description: The performance fee on each loan's profit, bps, 500 to 1500; the protocol receives 10% of it. Fixed for good

maxLoan.description: The most it puts into one loan, raw units of its asset (USDG: 6 decimals)

minRateGrade.description: The lowest Loan grade it funds, 0 (any) to 4 (A, the model's price or more). 3 (B, 90% of it) when omitted

name.description: The vault's name, as depositors see it: 1 to 48 bytes, no control or invisible characters. Its manager may change it

priorityFeeBps.description: The most it pays the protocol for a loan, bps of its profit, 0 to 5000: the vault paying most is funded first. 2000 when omitted

term.description: The longest loan it funds, in seconds: 604800 (7 days) or 1814400 (21 days)

universe.description: What it lends against: rwa (stocks and commodities) or ecosystem (meme and utility coins); it can never lend against both. rwa when omitted, a non-stable asset's vault always ecosystem

wallet.description: Who manages the vault, for good: the wallet that signs

name: gage_prepare_create_vault
title: Prepare: Create a partner vault
